% ===================================================================
%  Arabic blocks for the EPT cover page.  DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE.
%  It is \input from main.tex's preamble, after \usepackage{arabtex}.
%
%  Everything arabtex-sensitive lives here so that pg-EPT.tex -- the file
%  you actually edit -- contains no arabtex code at all.
%
%  Why this file is fragile:
%
%   * arabtex re-parses the body of `arabtext` itself.  A %-comment in
%     there swallows the environment's closing brace and the build dies
%     with "(\end occurred inside a group at level 1)".  So: no comments
%     between \begin{arabtext} and \end{arabtext}, ever.
%
%   * A size command (\footnotesize etc.) inside `arabtext` is not
%     reliably honoured -- it must be issued before the environment.
%
%   * "ص.ب" (= B.P.): arabtex reads a bare "." as a transliteration
%     modifier and swallows it, printing "صب" with the letters joined.
%     Passing the period through \LR restores it; the kerns pull back
%     \LR's default side spacing.
%
%   * Colons belong to the Arabic labels and must sit OUTSIDE \LR.
%     Inside it they get carried to the far end of the Latin run.
%
%   * Digit groups are written in the SAME order as the French block
%     opposite: \LR already sets its content left-to-right, so the
%     source must not pre-reverse them.
% ===================================================================

% Ministry / university header, right-hand cell of the cover masthead.
\newcommand{\EPTArabicHeader}{%
  \setcode{utf8}%
  \centering
  \begin{arabtext}
وزارة التعليـم العالي و البحث العلمي\\
جامعـة قرطاج\\
المدرسـة التونسية للتقنيات
  \end{arabtext}%
}

% Postal address / phone / fax / web, right-hand cell of the cover footer.
\newcommand{\EPTArabicFooter}{%
  \setcode{utf8}%
  \footnotesize
  \begin{arabtext}
نهج الخوارزمي ص\LR{\kern-2pt.\kern-2pt}ب \LR{743} المرسى \LR{2078}\\
الهاتف: \LR{71 774 611 - 71 774 699}\LR{\quad}الفاكس: \LR{71 748 843}\\
موقع الواب: \LR{www.ept.tn}
  \end{arabtext}%
}
